description.text: Trainer Battle Decks Pewter City Gym's Brock and Cerulean City Gym's Misty, two 60-card decks sold from 25 January 2019 at Pokémon Centers, recalling the Gym decks of the game's early years. Brock's deck holds two Onix-GX and Misty's two Starmie-GX, each with an original holo Trainer of its Gym Leader, Brock's Training or Misty's Water Command, and a Gym Stadium that works with its Pokémon-GX. Sleeves, a deck case, a coin, a long card box, damage counters, markers, a GX marker and a paper playmat came with each. This set holds the cards of both.
